Rolling build of the uwucrew tools. Each file is rebuilt automatically whenever its part of the code changes on `main`.

**uwucrew Sync addon:** `UwucrewSync.zip`. Unzip into your WoW Forever `Interface/AddOns` folder.

**uwucrew-sync app** (keeps your characters synced to Discord):
- Windows: `uwucrew-sync-windows.exe`. If SmartScreen warns, click *More info → Run anyway*.
- Mac (M1/M2/M3/M4): `uwucrew-sync-mac-apple-silicon.zip`
- Mac (Intel): `uwucrew-sync-mac-intel.zip`
- On a Mac, unzip, then right-click `uwucrew-sync` and choose *Open* the first time (it isn't notarized by Apple).
- Linux: `uwucrew-sync-linux.zip`

Setup: run `/sync link` in Discord, type `/uwu link <code>` in game, `/reload`, and leave the app running while you play.
